difficulty_why: Gmail apps requesting full access (https://mail.google.com/) must undergo multi-week restricted scope verification and a mandatory annual third-party CASA security assessment.

dev_time.label: 30-60 min
dev_time.text: Time required to create a Google Cloud project, enable the Gmail API, configure the consent screen, add test users, and obtain OAuth credentials.

launch_time.label: 4-8 weeks
launch_time.text: Restricted scope verification and the third-party CASA security assessment typically require around 6 weeks before the app can be used publicly without caps.

own_app_reasons.label: Verified custom branding
own_app_reasons.text: Display your own application name, logo, and verified domain on the Google authorization screen once verification is completed.

own_app_reasons.label: Scope customization
own_app_reasons.text: Configure and request the exact combination of Gmail and profile scopes required for your specific product features.

app_type.label: Web application (External)
app_type.text: Create an OAuth 2.0 client ID with application type 'Web application' and set the OAuth consent screen user type to 'External' to allow any Google user to authorize through Composio.

prerequisites.label: Google Account
prerequisites.text: A standard Google account with access to Google Cloud Console.

prerequisites.label: Google Cloud project
prerequisites.text: An active project in the Google Cloud Console.

prerequisites.label: Enabled Gmail API
prerequisites.text: The Gmail API enabled in the Google Cloud API Library for the project.

prerequisites.label: Verified domain in Search Console
prerequisites.text: A public domain owned and verified in Google Search Console matching the app's home and privacy policy pages.

prerequisites.label: Public Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
prerequisites.text: Publicly hosted Privacy Policy and Terms of Service URLs compliant with Google API Services User Data Policy.

steps.label: Select or create Google Cloud project
steps.text: Sign in to Google Cloud Console and select or create a project from the top project selector.

steps.label: Enable Gmail API
steps.text: Navigate to the API Library, search for Gmail API, and click Enable.

steps.label: Configure OAuth consent screen branding
steps.text: Go to OAuth consent screen, select External user type, and fill in the required app identity and contact details.

steps.label: Add OAuth scopes
steps.text: Click Add or Remove Scopes and select or enter the required Gmail and profile scopes including https://mail.google.com/.

steps.label: Add test users
steps.text: Under Test users, add the Google accounts of developers or testers who will test the app before verification.

fields.label: User email
fields.value: Developer and internal tester email addresses

steps.label: Create OAuth client ID
steps.text: Navigate to Credentials > Create Credentials > OAuth client ID, choose Web application, and add the Composio redirect URI.

steps.label: Record Client ID and Secret
steps.text: Copy and securely store the generated Client ID and Client Secret, noting that the secret cannot be viewed again in the console.

steps.label: Submit for verification and CASA audit
steps.text: Submit the app on the OAuth consent screen for verification and complete the CASA security assessment to lift the 100-user limit.

scopes.label: Gmail full access
scopes.text: https://mail.google.com/ grants full access to read, send, and permanently delete email; triggers full CASA security assessment.

scopes.label: Contacts read-only
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/contacts.readonly allows reading user contacts; classified as a sensitive scope requiring review.

scopes.label: Other contacts read-only
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/contacts.other.readonly allows reading other/implicit contacts; sensitive scope requiring review.

scopes.label: Profile language read
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/profile.language.read allows reading user language preferences; sensitive scope requiring review.

scopes.label: User addresses read
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.addresses.read allows reading user physical addresses; sensitive scope requiring review.

scopes.label: User birthday read
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.birthday.read allows reading user birthday; sensitive scope requiring review.

scopes.label: User emails read
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.emails.read allows reading user email addresses; sensitive scope requiring review.

scopes.label: User phone numbers read
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.phonenumbers.read allows reading user phone numbers; sensitive scope requiring review.

scopes.label: Profile emails read
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/profile.emails.read allows reading user profile emails; sensitive scope requiring review.

scopes.label: User profile info
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile allows viewing basic personal info; non-sensitive scope.

scopes.label: User primary email
scopes.text: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email allows viewing the primary Google account email; non-sensitive scope.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: Verification is mandatory prior to public launch whenever an app requests sensitive or restricted scopes such as https://mail.google.com/.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: Google verifies brand identity, Search Console domain ownership, privacy policy compliance, scope justification, and requires a CASA security assessment for restricted scopes.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Brand verification takes 2-3 business days, sensitive scope review takes 10 business days, and restricted scope verification takes approximately 6 weeks.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Google does not charge an OAuth review fee, but the mandatory third-party CASA Tier 2 security assessment typically costs between $500 and $4,500 annually.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: Unverified projects requesting sensitive or restricted scopes are capped at a non-resettable lifetime limit of 100 users across the project.

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: Unreviewed apps show an 'unverified app' warning interstitial to users, cannot exceed 100 lifetime users, and cannot distribute restricted scopes publicly.

pitfalls.label: Lifetime 100-user cap on unverified apps
pitfalls.text: Unverified apps requesting sensitive or restricted scopes are locked out after 100 lifetime users across the project; this limit is non-resettable.

pitfalls.label: AI model training prohibition
pitfalls.text: Google Workspace API User Data Policy strictly forbids using user data to train, fine-tune, or improve generalized foundational AI/ML models.

pitfalls.label: Client secret shown only once
pitfalls.text: Google Cloud Console displays the client secret only immediately upon creation, requiring you to copy and store it securely right away.

pitfalls.label: Search Console domain ownership requirement
pitfalls.text: The Google account requesting app verification must be a verified owner of the application domain in Google Search Console.

pitfalls.label: Scope mismatch disables sign-in
pitfalls.text: Requesting scopes in authorization calls that are not configured on the OAuth consent screen triggers sign-in disabled errors.

pitfalls.label: Annual CASA recertification required
pitfalls.text: Restricted scope verification is valid for one year; apps must complete an annual CASA security audit renewal to maintain access.

support.label: Google OAuth verification support email
support.text: Direct email support at api-oauth-support@google.com for app verification inquiries and document submission.

support.label: Google Cloud OAuth verification FAQ
support.text: Official Google Cloud Help FAQ on OAuth verification requirements, user caps, and restricted scope procedures.

support.text: Official documentation covering non-sensitive, sensitive, and restricted scopes for Gmail.

support.text: Documentation on implementing OAuth 2.0 authorization for web server applications.

email_subject: OAuth Verification & CASA Assessment Inquiry for Gmail App [APP_NAME]
email_body:
Hello Google API OAuth Support Team,

We are developing an AI agent application that enables users to integrate their Gmail accounts via OAuth 2.0 (using Composio as our integration gateway).

Our project requires the following scopes to manage user emails and basic profile info:
- https://mail.google.com/
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/contacts.readonly
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/contacts.other.readonly
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/profile.language.read
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.addresses.read
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.birthday.read
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.emails.read
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/user.phonenumbers.read
- https://www.googleapis.com/auth/profile.emails.read

Could you please clarify:
1. The latest CASA Tier 2 assessment workflow and approved lab audit requirements for https://mail.google.com/.
2. Expected review turnaround times for our Cloud Project [PROJECT_ID].
3. Any specific requirements for demonstrating adherence to the Workspace API User Data Policy regarding AI/ML usage.

Thank you,
[YOUR_NAME]
[YOUR_TITLE]
[YOUR_COMPANY]
[APP_NAME] / [PROJECT_ID]
